name: DTEmpire Adventure
features: Trading System - Player-to-player item and coin trading
Trade offers with items and coins

notes: Fixed hybrid potions (Mirage Flask, Frostfire Mixture, Cosmic Convergence, Abyssal Convergence, Elixir of Forever, Deep Tide Potion) — these carry BOTH a heal and an XP bonus, but the shop only ever saved one of the two, so every hybrid potion bought was permanently missing half its value.

Fixed drinking potions — the XP effect was swallowed by the heal check, so XP-granting potions healed you and silently gave 0 XP. Heal and XP now both apply, and level-ups from potion XP are granted correctly.

changes: 2 new monsters in Crystal Caverns: Diamond Wraith (+58 ATK) and Obsidian Guardian (+60 DEF)

notes: New shop item: ⚡ Primordius' Core (1,600,000 coins) — +4600 ATK & +4600 DEF & +26000 max HP permanently, top-tier upgrade beyond Astral Convergence for endgame players past Primordial Peak.

Fixed Temple of Elders offering (/api/temple/offer) — endpoint validated amount but never processed the donation, causing coin offerings to silently fail with no response. Now correctly deducts coins, grants XP (amount/2), and applies level-ups.

changes: New location: Primordial Peak (Lv.32+) — highest summit with Primordial Spark, Magma Titan, Storm Avatar, Cosmic Warden + Primordius, The First Born boss
Regenerated adventure_locations.json and guild_shops.json caches (fixed a stale corrupted guild_shops.json — items were flattened to strings, restored to full weapons/armor/potions/special dicts)
Dungeon UI zone selector updated with new Primordial Peak entry
Added Trading System (/trade page and API)
